rfps.title: Downtown Office Tower - High Voltage Electrical Systems
rfps.summary: Complete electrical installation for 25-story commercial office building including main service distribution (4000A), power distribution to all floors, LED lighting systems, emergency backup generators, and fire alarm systems. Must comply with San Francisco electrical codes, Title 24 energy standards, and LEED Gold certification requirements. C-10 license required.

rfps.title: Oakland Medical Center - HVAC & Medical Gas Systems
rfps.summary: Design-build HVAC system for medical facility expansion including specialized air filtration for surgical suites (ISO Class 7 cleanrooms), patient care areas with individual room controls, medical gas piping systems (oxygen, nitrous oxide, medical air), and emergency backup systems. Must meet OSHPD seismic requirements and healthcare facility standards. C-20 HVAC license and medical gas certification required.

rfps.title: Tech Campus Building C - Roofing & Solar Integration
rfps.summary: Complete roofing system installation for new 4-story office building including TPO membrane roofing, structural support for rooftop solar array (250kW), green roof sections with irrigation, and comprehensive waterproofing. Must include 20-year warranty and coordination with solar contractor. C-39 roofing license required.

rfps.title: Residential Complex Phase 2 - Foundation & Structural Framing
rfps.summary: Foundation excavation, concrete work, and structural framing for 200-unit residential development. Includes site preparation, underground utilities coordination, post-tension concrete foundations, structural steel and concrete framing for 4-story buildings, and seismic bracing per California Building Code. Requires trenching and excavation safety plan. Class B General Contractor license required.

rfps.title: Metro Transit Hub - Plumbing & Fire Protection Systems
rfps.summary: Complete plumbing and fire protection systems for transit station renovation including domestic water distribution, sanitary waste systems, storm drainage, automatic fire sprinkler systems throughout, and standpipe systems. Must coordinate with existing operational transit systems. Asbestos abatement work zones require pollution liability coverage. C-36 plumbing license required.
